result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and wide sidewalks in a mixed-use urban setting. While tactical daylighting with flexible bollards is present on one side, the lack of pedestrian-specific signals and potential sightline obstructions from parked vehicles remain concerns.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb can block the visibility of pedestrians for approaching drivers, especially on the side without bollards.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway, beyond the bollards

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: The intersection is controlled by a traffic light but lacks dedicated pedestrian countdown or walk signals.
hazards.location_in_image: On the utility pole at the left corner

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals to provide clear timing information for people crossing the street.

interventions.title: Permanent Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Replace the temporary bollards with permanent concrete curb extensions to further shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting with Signage
interventions.description: Ensure parking is restricted near the crosswalk on all corners with clear signage to maintain sight lines.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks and well-maintained sidewalks. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the wide roadway creates a significant crossing distance without intermediate refuge islands.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to traffic for a significant duration across multiple lanes without a median or refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Main intersection crossing in the foreground

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns across pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and increase visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalks to improve sightlines.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and traffic signals on a one-way street with sidewalks on both sides. However, visibility is compromised by vehicles parked close to the crossing, and the absence of dedicated pedestrian signals or curb extensions increases risk for people crossing.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: A large white van is parked very close to the crosswalk, potentially blocking the view of pedestrians for oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, just past the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, which may lead to confusion about when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

result.summary: The image depicts an urban intersection with mixed-use buildings but a complete lack of pedestrian safety infrastructure. There are no marked crosswalks, traffic control devices, or curb ramps visible, forcing pedestrians to cross an wide, unmarked roadway with potential sightline obstructions from parked cars.

hazards.name: Unmarked Intersection
hazards.description: The intersection lacks any painted crosswalks or traffic control devices, leaving pedestrians unprotected while crossing.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the intersection corners may block the view between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style painted crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.
